purpose: Prequalify a physically stressed contract for the A2/A3 question. Only floorplan keys change; the SDC, spec, TB, reference, tools, seed and corner are unchanged, so synthesis evidence and the synthesis-promotable set stay valid.

sample.promotable_definition: C0 synthesis table: functional and mapped PASS, VALID area and slack, slack >= 0, changed fingerprint, area >= 0.5% below the raw golden

selection_rule.choose: the first contract (mildest) satisfying every condition
conditions: both raw goldens routed ACCEPTED with detailed_route_extraction
all repeat pairs match the main run exactly on synthesis and routed decision metrics
for each design, the routed rejection rate among sampled promotable configurations is within [0.15, 0.60]
no unresolved or timed-out outcome among the sampled configurations
selection_rule.otherwise: report that no contract qualifies; do not tune the contract after seeing the results
